title: Serene Watersports
specs: Calm water with two islands to tour
Abundant local wildlife including fish, muskrats, turtles, deer, and swans
Children 10 and under must ride with an adult
Wear comfortable footwear that can get wet; no high heels
blurb: Guests rent watercraft such as kayaks, paddle boards, pedal boats, and a large dock to explore the Grand River at Shade's Mills Conservation Area. Rentals include life jackets and basic instructions for first-time paddlers. The area features calm water, two islands to tour, and abundant wildlife.
extraNote: Rentals are first come, first serve · Minimum one hour rental · No switching rental party or equipment use · Equipment may not be taken to the beach or Shade’s Mills swimming area · Late returns charged additional fee · Launch site at 450 Avenue Road in Cambridge, GRCA Shades Mill Conservation Area, just north of the beach.
